# Ankhorage Runtime

![license: MIT](./paradox/badges/license.svg) ![npm: v5.7.1](./paradox/badges/npm.svg) ![runtime: bun](./paradox/badges/runtime.svg) ![typescript: strict](./paradox/badges/typescript.svg) ![eslint: checked](./paradox/badges/eslint.svg) ![prettier: checked](./paradox/badges/prettier.svg) ![build: checked](./paradox/badges/build.svg) ![tests: configured](./paradox/badges/tests.svg) ![paradox: warnings](./paradox/badges/docs.svg)

Renders Ankhorage application manifests and resolves their runtime bindings, capabilities, events, media, screens, and state.

Provide a platform-neutral runtime boundary that turns portable Ankhorage manifests into rendered application behavior without coupling consumers to a particular host application.

## Usage

### Basic Usage

`@ankhorage/runtime` owns platform-neutral runtime renderer contracts for generated apps.

Host apps keep router, theme, and other framework-specific behavior outside this package and
inject it at the runtime boundary.

```ts
createRuntimeManifest({
  config: {
    appId: 'demo',
  },
});
```
